ground_truth.description: The fallback `(load && load[m.key]) || { current: null, sparkline: [] }` only substitutes the default when the whole metric object is missing. If the API returns a metric object present but lacking `sparkline` (or with `sparkline: null`), `datum.sparkline` is passed to <Sparkline> as undefined/null, which could break rendering. A safer access would default the sparkline field itself.

`fetchLoad` is fired on a fixed 5000ms interval with no in-flight guard; if a request takes longer than 5s (slow network/server), multiple overlapping fetches can be issued and complete out of order, potentially showing stale values momentarily. Minor since each response fully replaces state.

task.title: OCCT throttle L3: dashboard Host load card with live values + 5-min sparklines
task.description:
Frontend card in the dashboard's redux SPA rendering the host load metrics with live values + 5-min sparklines. Polls `/api/load` (ζ) every 5 s.

Implementation:
- Add a new card section "Host load" to `dashboard/src/dashboard/static/redux/tab_overview.jsx` (tactical: implementer may instead create `tab_load.jsx` per PRD open question 2; default is overview-tab extension).
- One row per metric showing:
  - Formatted current value:
    - PSI metrics: percentage with two decimals (`12.34%`) and "some/full" label.
    - `verify_rss_total_bytes`: GiB with one decimal (`2.3 GiB`).
    - `occt_queue_depth`, `verify_concurrency`: integer.
  - 5-min sparkline (reuse existing sparkline component from `charts.jsx`).
- Empty-data state shows `—` not synthetic data (per feedback_redux_no_synthetic_data).
- Restart the dashboard after deploying (per feedback_dashboard_restart_after_backend_merge); document this in the task's done-note.
- Frontend tests in `dashboard/tests/` covering: card renders with empty data; card renders with populated data; polling triggers re-fetch (mocked).

PRD: dark-factory/plans/occt-throttle-layer-2-3.md task η
User-observable signal (LEAF for Unit 2): Firefox at `http://localhost:<dash-port>/redux` shows a "Host load" card on the overview tab. Each metric row renders the formatted current value per metric type and a sparkline whose data points correspond to the last 60 samples (sparkline path is non-empty SVG when ≥ 2 samples exist; values may be zero on an idle host but the rendering is non-stub). Under verify load induced during testing (run reify `verify.sh all` in a loop for 60 s) the sparklines visibly rise. Two screenshots — idle baseline and induced-load — are the close criterion, paired with a network-trace observation that `/api/load` is being polled every 5 s.
Consumer: end user (dashboard operator diagnosing host load).
Modules touched: dashboard/src/dashboard/static/redux/tab_overview.jsx (or new tab_load.jsx), dashboard/src/dashboard/static/redux/charts.jsx (reuse), dashboard/tests/

Browser-cache caveat: Firefox caches dashboard HTML/JS aggressively (feedback_browser_cache_firefox); ?v=N bumps may not suffice — Ctrl+Shift+R during local validation.
